verses.en_bbe: And Job made answer and said,

verses.en: Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.
verses.pt: Até hoje minha queixa é uma amargura; a mão de Deus sobre mim é mais pesada que meu gemido.
verses.en_web: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.
verses.en_bbe: Even today my outcry is bitter; his hand is hard on my sorrow.

verses.en: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!
verses.pt: Ah se eu soubesse como poderia achá-lo! Então eu me chegaria até seu trono.
verses.en_web: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
verses.en_bbe: If only I had knowledge of where he might be seen, so that I might come even to his seat!

verses.en: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
verses.pt: Apresentaria minha causa diante dele, e encheria minha boca de argumentos.
verses.en_web: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
verses.en_bbe: I would put my cause in order before him, and my mouth would be full of arguments.

verses.en: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.
verses.pt: Eu saberia as palavras que ele me responderia, e entenderia o que me diria.
verses.en_web: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.
verses.en_bbe: I would see what his answers would be, and have knowledge of what he would say to me.

verses.en: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.
verses.pt: Por acaso ele brigaria comigo com seu grande poder? Não, pelo contrário, ele me daria atenção.
verses.en_web: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.
verses.en_bbe: Would he make use of his great power to overcome me? No, but he would give attention to me.

verses.en: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.
verses.pt: Ali o íntegro pleitearia com ele, e eu me livraria para sempre de meu Juiz.
verses.en_web: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.
verses.en_bbe: There an upright man might put his cause before him; and I would be free for ever from my judge.

verses.en: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:
verses.pt: Eis que se eu for ao oriente, ele não está ali; se for ao ocidente, e não o percebo;
verses.en_web: “If I go east, he is not there; if west, I can’t find him;
verses.en_bbe: See, I go forward, but he is not there; and back, but I do not see him;

verses.en: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:
verses.pt: Se ao norte ele opera, eu não o vejo; se ele se esconde ao sul, não o enxergo.
verses.en_web: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.
verses.en_bbe: I am looking for him on the left hand, but there is no sign of him; and turning to the right, I am not able to see him.

verses.en: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
verses.pt: Porém ele conhece meu caminho: Provar-me-á, e sairei como ouro.
verses.en_web: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I shall come out like gold.
verses.en_bbe: For he has knowledge of the way I take; after I have been tested I will come out like gold.

verses.en: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.
verses.pt: Meus pés seguiram seus passos; guardei seu caminho, e não me desviei.
verses.en_web: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.
verses.en_bbe: My feet have gone in his steps; I have kept in his way, without turning to one side or to the other.

verses.en: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
verses.pt: Nunca retirei de mim o preceito de seus lábios, e guardei as palavras de sua boca mais que minha porção de comida.
verses.en_web: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
verses.en_bbe: I have never gone against the orders of his lips; the words of his mouth have been stored up in my heart.

verses.en: But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.
verses.pt: Porém se ele está decidido, quem poderá o desviar? O que sua alma quiser, isso fará.
verses.en_web: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.
verses.en_bbe: But his purpose is fixed and there is no changing it; and he gives effect to the desire of his soul.

verses.en: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.
verses.pt: Pois ele cumprirá o que está determinado para mim; ele ainda tem muitas coisas como estas consigo.
verses.en_web: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.
verses.en_bbe: For what has been ordered for me by him will be gone through to the end: and his mind is full of such designs.

verses.en: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.
verses.pt: Por isso eu me perturbo em sua presença. Quando considero isto,tenho medo dele.
verses.en_web: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause I am in fear before him, my thoughts of him overcome me.

verses.en: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:
verses.pt: Deus enfraqueceu meu coração; o Todo-Poderoso tem me perturbado.
verses.en_web: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.
verses.en_bbe: For God has made my heart feeble, and my mind is troubled before the Ruler of all.

verses.en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.
verses.pt: Pois não estou destruído por causa das trevas, nem por causa da escuridão que encobriu meu rosto.
verses.en_web: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
verses.en_bbe: For I am overcome by the dark, and by the black night which is covering my face.
